entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: A child pulling on her mother's clothes?

entries.speaker: (壁画の声)少女
entries.en: Mom...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: More voices...

entries.speaker: (壁画の声)少女
entries.en: I'm... I'm tired of eating dinner[n]alone all the time.

entries.speaker: (壁画の声)少女
entries.en: It's always just convenience[n]store bentos...

entries.speaker: (壁画の声)少女
entries.en: I wanna go somewhere.[n]Take me on a trip!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: The one clinging to her mother[n]would be Futaba-chan, right?

entries.speaker: (壁画の声)若い女性
entries.en: Don't be so selfish!

entries.speaker: (壁画の声)若い女性
entries.en: You know I'm working hard[n]to support you, right!?

entries.speaker: (壁画の声)若い女性
entries.en: Ugh!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: She seemed pretty angry...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Is that the maternity neurosis[n]the voice from earlier mentioned?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I thought it was pretty normal for[n]a child to want to spend time with[n]their parents though...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah. Looks like Futaba was a[n]pretty lonely kid growin' up...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So these incidents compounded, forcing[n]her mother to suicide?
entries.uk: То такі випадки накопичувалися[n]й довели її матір до самогубства?

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: ...I must die.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh?

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: I killed her... That's why I'm here in this[n]tomb...
entries.uk: Я вбила її... Тому я тут, у цій[n]гробниці...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Don't say that!

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: I will die...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Futaba-chan!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Why'd she get so quiet all of a sudden?[n]What happened to that snarky[n]personality!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Could her heart perhaps[n]be growing weaker?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We have to hurry and save her!
